# `assets/` — Generated Static Assets

Generated static assets for the README and social previews.

**Do not edit manually.** Regenerate via:

```bash
python scripts/generate_assets.py
# or
make assets
```

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `charts/01_top-skills.png` | Top in-demand skills. |
| `charts/02_salary-by-role.png` | Salary distribution by role. |
| `charts/03_skill-cooccurrence-heatmap.png` | Skill co-occurrence heatmap. |
| `charts/04_salary-vs-experience.png` | Salary versus minimum experience. |
| `charts/05_top-companies.png` | Companies with the most postings. |
| `charts/06_median-salary-by-workplace.png` | Median salary by workplace type. |
| `charts/07_skill-vs-salary.png` | Salary premium associated with skills. |
| `charts/08_experience-vs-salary-money-plot.png` | Salary and experience money plot. |
| `charts/09_role-vs-salary.png` | Salary distribution by role. |
| `charts/10_company-vs-remote.png` | Role distribution preview. |
